claims.explanation: BAY-11-7082 is an NF-kB pathway inhibitor that also covalently inhibits the NLRP3 inflammasome and ubiquitin-conjugating enzymes, so selectivity likely reflects dependence on constitutive NF-kB/inflammasome signaling and on the drug's broader cysteine-reactive, proteostasis/ubiquitin-related effects. The most sensitive lines are enriched for TP53 mutation and RAS/RTK-MAPK pathway activation (BRAF, NRAS, MAP2K1, EGFR, MET, KRAS), whereas many resistant lines retain wild-type or less NF-kB-dependent contexts, suggesting that TP53 loss plus MAPK/RTK-driven NF-kB activity sensitizes tumors to this compound.

features.basis: TP53 mutation is highly enriched among the most killed lines and is consistent with loss of p53-mediated survival/apoptosis control under NF-kB inhibition
BRAF-mutant melanoma and other lines are among the most sensitive, consistent with MAPK-driven NF-kB/inflammatory signaling dependence
NRAS-mutant melanoma line IPC298 is strongly killed, suggesting RAS-MAPK activation contributes to sensitivity
MAP2K1-mutant NCIH1437 is among the most sensitive lines, supporting MAPK pathway dependence
EGFR-mutant NCIH1650 is strongly killed, while EGFR-mutant HCC4006 is resistant, so this is weaker but consistent with RTK-driven NF-kB activation
MET-mutant HGC27 is among the most sensitive lines, suggesting RTK-driven NF-kB signaling
KRAS-mutant T3M4 pancreas is sensitive, though KRAS mutations also appear in resistant lines, so this is weak
BAY-11-7082 targets RELA/NF-kB, so high RELA pathway activity should increase dependence on NF-kB survival signaling
Constitutive NF-kB activity is the annotated mechanism and is associated with sensitivity in lymphoma/leukemia models
NF-kB-driven Bcl-xL expression can protect cells; high BCL2L1 may reduce apoptosis from NF-kB inhibition
BAY-11-7082 directly inhibits caspase-1/inflammasome activity, so inflammasome-dependent lines may be more affected
BAY-11-7082 selectively inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome activity independent of NF-kB, suggesting NLRP3-high lines may be sensitive
